arguments.command:
python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo, _LAST_NUMBER

v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, build='build1')
print('build:', v.build)
match = _LAST_NUMBER.search(v.build)
print('match:', match)
if match:
    print('group(1):', match.group(1))
"
